This screen opens as a pivot. Change the time granularity by\n clicking the column header and choosing Day / Week / Month /\n Quarter / Year — not by hunting for a filter.

Taking Plant out of the rows adds the plants together; leaving it in sets them side by side. For a running total from the start of the year turn on Year to date, and add Same period last year to compare two years.

Only the figures that can be added are here — energy, energy lost, revenue. Capacity factor, availability % and the level achieved against P50 are ratios, wrong to add and wrong to average, so they live on the Availability by day and Energy target screens.
